name: Stone of Retreat: Hammertoe Digsite lands at the Explorers' League camp (#13098)
contract: #13098: spell 1777074 says Returns you to Hammertoe Digsite in the Badlands. Its spell_target_position row copied
the spawn of Hammertoe Grez inside the Uldaman entry cave (-6065.44, -3022.03), among hostile Shadowforge dwarves.
Ascension's client teleport pin for 1777074 (TeleportLocations.lua, sor-hammertoe-digsite) is the Explorers'
League camp at (-6615.76, -3412.74, 279.27), beside Prospector Ryedol and Sigrun Ironhew. An Alliance player learns
the spell from item 1780039 through the native item-use handler, casts it, and must land within 10 yd of the camp
point; the cave point is 675 yd away.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: lands at the digsite camp, not in the Uldaman cave
